title: 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe with frozen outer layers and reduced step size
scientific_hypothesis: Freezing the first two and last two layers at proven optimal thicknesses while optimizing inner 8 layers with low-variance initialization will stabilize convergence and exploit the 0.30+ performance basin without large resonance-jumps.
design_principle: Partial freezing reduces search space dimensionality while preserving boundary conditions that contribute to impedance matching. Low-variance Gaussian initialization (σ=5 nm, center 750 nm) prevents optimizer from jumping between distant local minima.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge (12 finite layers, alternating starting with ZnS)
design_variables: Outer 4 layer thicknesses frozen at iteration_13 optimal values
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 500-1500 nm for inner layers
Outer layers fixed at 417 nm (ZnS) and 455 nm (ZnSe) per iteration_13
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack principle for dichroic filtering
Partial freezing reduces optimization dimensionality while preserving boundary impedance matching
expected_advantages: Reduced search space improves optimizer efficiency
known_risks: Frozen outer layers may not be optimal for 12-layer configuration
Inner layer initialization may bias toward suboptimal local minimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer alternating ZnS/ZnSe stack on Ge substrate at normal incidence. Layers 1-2 and 11-12 frozen at thicknesses 417 nm (ZnS) and 455 nm (ZnSe) respectively. Layers 3-10 optimizable with thickness bounds 500-1500 nm, initialized with Gaussian distribution centered at 750 nm with standard deviation 5 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate 0.015 (half of previous 0.03). Spectral range 3000-11000 nm sampled at 2001 points. Maximize transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band while minimizing transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. Coherent TMM solver. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: freeze outer layers at iteration_13 optimal values, reduce optimizer step size by half, initialize inner layers with low-variance Gaussian to prevent resonance-jumps between rounds.
